annotations.title: Rate a template the person copied

description: Gives a public template the person copied and connected 1 to 5 stars, with an optional short review (up to 280 characters, no links, email addresses or long numbers), shown on its public page under their public name, or as "A TrackerHacker user" when they haven't set one. Rate only when the person says how many stars, and use their own words for the review; rating again replaces it. To find which template a track was copied from, pass trackId alone: nothing is rated, and you get the template and the person's rating so far.

review.description: Up to 280 characters, in the person's words.

trackId.description: The track whose sheet is a copy of the template.
